Generated typed TomSpecs object-model facade (C).

## Where this fits

`tom_som_c_v0` is the **generated typed face** of the TomSpecs object model for C: one type per document section, so a specification is read and written through named members rather than through string paths. It exists because a string path is checked only at run time — a mistyped one reads as an absent value instead of an error — and a specification is exactly the kind of document where that failure is silent and expensive. It is one half of a pair: the hand-written [`tom_som_c_runtime`](../tom_som_c_runtime) holds everything identical in every language (the sparse document store, the codecs, the validator) and this half holds only what changes when the model changes, so a regeneration rewrites the typed types and touches nothing else. The same pair exists for all nine SOM languages, generated from one model, so a document written through any of them reads identically through the other eight. There is no registry: both halves build to a static and a shared library with a pkg-config `.pc` file, so `make install` and `pkg-config --cflags --libs` are the integration surface.

## Overview

A TomSpecs document is **sparse and path-keyed**: a value lives under the globally-unique section-id path it belongs to, and an absent key means "no value" rather than an empty one. This package holds none of those values — `SpecDocument`, in the runtime, does. What it holds is a typed **view**: each generated type wraps a document together with the path prefix it is rooted at, and its members resolve to the paths beneath that prefix. Constructing a document root also runs the model-version check (`SOM §4.2`), so a document stamped by a different model version is refused rather than silently misread.

Everything generated here is derived from the `tom_specs_model` Dart model and rewritten wholesale on every run of `tom_specs_clitool/bin/generate_som.dart`. Beside the typed types the package ships the lossless meta-data file (`meta/spec_model.meta.json`, `SOM §5.3`), the generated DocSpecs schemas (`schemas/`, `SOM §13`), and the metadata trees that drive the dot-notation and id-tree access surfaces (`SOM §8`). The hand-written trees beside them — `examples/`, the tests, `doc/` — are preserved across regeneration; the generator writes files, it never wipes the output root.

## Installation

C has no package registry. Install the facade and the runtime (runtime first — the facade links against it), then let `pkg-config` supply the compile and link flags:

```bash
make -C ../tom_som_c_runtime install
make install
cc myapp.c $(pkg-config --cflags --libs tom_som_c_v0) -o myapp
```

The facade `.pc` declares `Requires: tom_som_c_runtime`, so a single `pkg-config tom_som_c_v0` pulls in the runtime flags too. Both `.pc` files report `Version 1.1.0`.

`tom_som_c_v0` and `tom_som_c_runtime` both carry version `1.1.0`, taken from the TomSpecs model version — pin them together. Every other dependency route (git, path, vendored, build-from-source) is in [readme_howtointegrate.md](readme_howtointegrate.md).

## Features

### Document roots

Each root is a whole TomSpecs document, and the first segment of every path beneath it is its section id. Construct the root you need over a `SpecDocument`; the 1254 generated types are reached through it.

| Section id | Document | Generated root type |
| ---------- | -------- | ------------------- |
| `SBP` | Solution Blueprint | `D00SolutionBlueprint` |
| `CLA` | Current Landscape Assessment | `D01CurrentLandscapeAssessment` |
| `TOM` | Target Operating Model | `D02TargetOperatingModel` |
| `IFM` | Information Model | `D03InformationModel` |
| `RSP` | Requirements Specification | `D04RequirementsSpecification` |
| `ISC` | Interaction Scenarios | `D05InteractionScenarios` |
| `ATS` | Architecture & Technology Specification | `D06ArchitectureTechnologySpecification` |
| `IIS` | Integration & Interface Specification | `D07IntegrationInterfaceSpecification` |
| `SAS` | Security & Access Specification | `D08SecurityAccessSpecification` |
| `XDS` | Experience Design Specification | `D09ExperienceDesignSpecification` |
| `QAP` | Quality & Acceptance Plan | `D10QualityAcceptancePlan` |
| `DRM` | Delivery Roadmap | `D11DeliveryRoadmap` |
| `TRP` | Transition & Rollout Plan | `D12TransitionRolloutPlan` |
| `CGP` | CodeSpecs Generation Projection | `D13CodeSpecsProjection` |

## Quick start

Build and install `tom_som_c_v0` (and `tom_som_c_runtime`), then compile against it with `pkg-config`:

```c
#include "tom_som_c_v0.h"

int main(void) {
  // A typed Solution Blueprint over a fresh document. The constructor also runs
  // the instantiation-time model-version check (an empty stamp is editable).
  SpecDocument doc;
  spec_document_init(&doc);

  D00SolutionBlueprint bp;
  d00_solution_blueprint_new(&bp, &doc, "", NULL);

  d00_solution_blueprint_set_content(
      &bp, "A platform that unifies our fragmented order systems.");

  CurrentLandscape cl = d00_solution_blueprint_current_landscape(&bp);
  current_landscape_set_content(
      &cl, "Three legacy systems with no shared customer record.");

  char *content = d00_solution_blueprint_content(&bp);
  printf("%s\n", content);
  free(content);

  current_landscape_free(&cl);
  d00_solution_blueprint_free(&bp);
  spec_document_free(&doc);
  return 0;
}
```

Prints `A platform that unifies our fragmented order systems.` — the value just written, read back through the typed getter.

## Usage

### The generic store underneath

A facade is a view; the document is the value. Reach past the typed types whenever a path is computed rather than known — both sides address exactly the same store.

```c
#include "tom_som_c_runtime.h"
#include "tom_som_c_v0_meta.h"

SpecDocument doc;
spec_document_init(&doc);
spec_document_set_content(
    &doc, "SBP/content",
    "A platform that unifies our fragmented order systems.");

/* A repeated section: each append returns the new item's OWNED path. */
char *item = spec_document_add_list_item(
    &doc, "SBP/currentLandscape/CUOPME-OPER-LST");
char *leaf = spec_path_join(item, "content");
spec_document_set_content(&doc, leaf, "Average order turnaround: 4.2 days.");
free(leaf);
free(item);

/* encode_yaml also returns an owned buffer the caller frees. */
char *err = NULL;
char *yaml = encode_yaml(&doc, d00_solution_blueprint_meta_tree(), "1.0", &err);
printf("%s", yaml);
free(yaml);
spec_document_free(&doc);
```

### Metadata and reflection

The exported class graph answers "what *can* the model hold?" with no document values involved — enumerate roots and fields, or resolve a concrete path to the model node it lands on (`SOM §7`).

```c
#include "tom_som_c_runtime.h"

char *err = NULL;
SpecModel *model = spec_model_from_json_str(data, &err);
SpecReflection ref = spec_reflection_make(model);

/* The roots are model data; the reflection resolves paths against them. */
for (size_t i = 0; i < model->roots_len; i++) {
  const SpecRoot *root = &model->roots[i];
  printf("%s  %s
", spec_reflection_root_segment(root), root->title);
}

SpecResolution res;
if (spec_reflection_resolve(&ref, "SBP/currentLandscape/content", &res)) {
  printf("kind=%s  value_leaf=%d
", res.kind,
         spec_resolution_is_value_leaf(&res));
  spec_resolution_free(&res);
}
spec_model_free(model);
```

### Regenerating

This package is output. When the model changes, regenerate it rather than editing it — every file carrying the `GENERATED … do not edit by hand` banner is overwritten:

```bash
dart run tom_specs_clitool/bin/generate_som.dart
```

## Architecture

```
  tom_som_c_v0          the typed path — this package
    D00SolutionBlueprint …        one type per document root
            │  extends
            ▼
     SomNode / SomScalar / SomList     editing-facade bases
            │  bound to
            ▼
      SpecDocument                sparse, path-keyed value store
            │                     (tom_som_c_runtime)
            ▼
  SpecReflection · SpecValidator · YAML + Markdown codecs
            ▲
            │  described by
      SomMetaTree  ◀── meta/spec_model.meta.json
```

| Type | Responsibility |
| ---- | -------------- |
| `D00SolutionBlueprint` … | The generated document roots — one per row of the table above, each the typed entry point to a whole document. |
| `SomNode` | The base every generated section type extends: a document plus the path prefix this section is rooted at. |
| `SomScalar` | A typed leaf — parse and format at the store boundary, so `int` / `bool` / enum members read as themselves. |
| `SomList` | A typed repeated section — append, index and enumerate items whose paths the store generates. |
| `SomMetaTree` / `SomMetaNode` | The generated metadata trees (`SOM §7`): the model's shape as data, behind the dot-notation and id-tree access surfaces. |
| `SomEditability` | The `SOM §4.2` version-check outcome — whether a stamped document may be edited by this facade. |
| `SpecDocument` | The value store itself. Lives in `tom_som_c_runtime`; every type above is a view onto it. |

## Ecosystem

```
  tom_specs_model          the Dart model — the source of truth
         │
         ▼  generate_som
  tom_specs_clitool        the generator
         │
         ▼  emits
  tom_som_c_v0   ← this package (typed)
         │
         ▼  depends on
  tom_som_c_runtime  (generic, hand-written)
         │
         ▼  validated against
  tom_som_conformance      the shared cross-language corpus
```

The same shape repeats for all nine languages; the corpus at the bottom is shared, which is what makes "identical in every language" a measured claim rather than an intention (`SOM §19`).
